text:
Anna K: Heads up — I'm kicking off coordination for the new runtime metrics + dashboards we promised for Q2. Need infra + runtime + DevEx alignment on exporters, aggregation cadence, retention, and a backfill strategy. Initial metric set: per-route p95 latency, tokens_per_request, model_fallback_rate, kv_cache_hit_ratio, route_quota_usage. Any showstoppers?

Kevin L: Can runtime emit structured labels (route_id, model_family, deployment_id)? Prom-style labels are easiest for dashboards but cardinality is a concern.

Marta S: +1 on structured labels. Important note: don't emit full request path as a label. Use route_id and a short route_group tag. For high-card routes we should sample or aggregate at source.

Raj P: Storage/cost question — raw high-cardinality time series for 365d will blow S3 and TSDB costs. Proposal from infra: keep raw (1s/1m) for 30d, keep 1h aggregates for 365d, and support on-demand backfill for up to 90d.

Anna K: That sounds reasonable. DevEx: UX needs both short-term live panels (real-time, 1m) and long-term trend panels. We also need per-route quota burn rate and per-token cost breakdown in the Console.

DevEx: For Console UX, we want APIs to return pre-aggregated panels to avoid client-side heavy queries. Ideally an endpoint like `/api/metrics/dashboard_panes?route_id=...&range=30d` that returns the aggregates.

Kevin L: Internal API debate: should runtime push to Prometheus exporters or to a batching push gateway that writes protobufs to Kafka? Prom is simple but scraping runtime pods across Dedicated clusters is messy. Push->Kafka gives us centralized processing and cheaper long-term storage.

Marta S: Push->Kafka + transform pipeline lets us produce both raw timeseries and aggregates during ingestion. We can apply cardinality controls there.

Raj P: Agree. Our recommended pattern: runtime -> exporter-daemon (local agent) -> kafka topic `metrics.raw.v1` -> stream processors -> aggregates -> tsdb/s3. That lets us insert sampling/labels policy in one place.

Anna K: Example exporter config for runtime sidecar (proposal):
```
exporter:
  push_mode: kafka
  topic: metrics.raw.v1
  labels: [route_id, model_family, deployment_id, env]
  sampling:
    default: 1.0
    high_card_routes: 0.05
```

Kevin L: Suggest we version the metric names now — `redwood.router.p95_ms` and `redwood.tokens.per_request` etc. Versioning avoids UX breakage during rollouts.

Marta S: On aggregation jobs: cadence suggestion: 1m -> 5m -> 1h -> 1d jobs. Name aggregator job `metrics_aggregator_v2`. Aggregator should support windowed dedupe for bursty routes.

Raj P: Retention concrete numbers infra can support w/ current budget: raw 30d, 5m/1h aggregates 365d, 1d aggregates 5y (cost-per-unit permitting). Backfill window we can commit to: 60 days if funded; otherwise 30 days free + paid backfill.

DevEx: For Console latency panels we need p50/p95/p99 and also a small sparkline for fallback-rate (model variant fallback). Can we emit `model_fallback_count` and `model_fallback_attempts` to compute rate?

Anna K: Yes — add `redwood.model.fallback.count` and `redwood.model.fallback.attempts`. Also need `kv_cache_hits` and `kv_cache_requests` for hit ratio.

Kevin L: Ops note: label cardinality guardrails must be enforced at exporter-daemon. If a runtime tries to set `user_id` as a label, drop it and emit a telemetry event so we can find offenders.

Marta S: Backfill plan: we'll run a backfill job that reads historical logs from S3 (+raw metrics topic for the >30d gap) and replays into aggregates. ETA for a 60d backfill for 30 nodes ~ 6 hours if parallelized. Need a maintenance window for heavy IO.

Raj P: I'll budget a one-off infra window and disk IO priority. Also propose we throttle backfill to not affect production query latency.

Anna K: Decision points summary (please ack): 1) Runtime -> exporter-daemon -> Kafka push (not Prom scrape). 2) Labels: route_id, model_family, deployment_id, env. No unbounded labels. 3) Retention: raw 30d, 1h aggregates 365d, 1d 5y (TBD). 4) Backfill: 30d included, 60d if funded. 5) Aggregation cadence: 1m/5m/1h/1d.

Kevin L: ACK to 1/2/5. +1 on metric name versioning.

Marta S: ACK to 1/2/5. Concern on 3/4 costs — need signoff from finance for 5y.

Raj P: ACK to 1/2/3/5. Will follow up on backfill ops runbook and cost estimate for 60d vs 30d.

DevEx: ACK. I'll draft the Console API contract and sample panels tomorrow.

sre-bot: incident: none detected. Reminder: schedule post-deploy smoke for exporter-daemon on staging.

Anna K: Next steps — I'll create an RFC + action item list in #eng-docs and assign owners (runtime: Kevin, infra: Raj, devex: DevEx, aggregator: Marta). Let's sync Wed 10am. :+1:

Marta S: Bringing `metrics_aggregator_v2` into our weekly job queue. Will add dedupe/windowing PR.

Kevin L: I'll prototype the exporter-daemon change for label enforcement and push mode this week.

Raj P: I'll produce cost delta numbers for 30d vs 60d backfill and the expected S3/TSDB impact.

DevEx: I'll sketch the Console panes and the dashboard API contract.

Anna K: Thanks everyone — posting RFC link when done.
